question: Simplify: (0.overline{39}+0.overline{53}-0.overline{27})
solution:
**Given:**

0.overline{39} + 0.overline{53} - 0.overline{27}

**Formula used:**

0.overline{ab} = (ab)/(99)

**Calculations:**

0.overline{39} + 0.overline{53} - 0.overline{27}

⇒ (39)/(99) + (53)/(99) - (27)/(99)

⇒ (39 + 53 - 27)/(99)

⇒ (92 - 27)/(99)

⇒ (65)/(99)

⇒ 0.overline{65}

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
